Home.title: LinguaPath
Home.intro: The platform is being built. This page checks that languages, right-to-left layout, themes and design tokens work.

Import.title: Import users
Import.intro: Upload a CSV, check the preview, then apply. Nothing changes until you apply.
Import.formatHelp: Row 1 must have these column names. Students need a username; staff need an email. Missing classes and grades are created in the current year. Up to 300 rows per file.

Cards.goTo: Go to the LinguaPath student sign-in page
Cards.title: Login cards · {class}
Cards.intro: Print a card for each student. PINs are stored securely, so printing creates new ones.
Cards.printHint: Tip: choose “Save as PDF” in the print dialog to keep a copy.
Cards.confirm: Replace the PINs of {count} students? Their old PINs stop working.
Cards.warning: Generating cards gives every student in this class a new PIN.

Roles.title: Roles & permissions
Roles.intro: Tick a box to give a permission to everyone holding that role. Changes apply at once.

Supervision.title: Supervision
Supervision.intro: Who supervises whom. Dashboards and reports follow these links.
Supervision.applyDefaultsHelp: Links principals and vice principals to their staff from their roles. Existing links are kept.

Audit.title: Audit log
Audit.intro: Every change to permissions, roles, supervision and school structure. Entries can't be edited or deleted.

Gates.freePeriodEnded: This school's free period ended on {date}. Please contact the platform owner.

Visibility.title: Visibility Studio
Visibility.intro: Choose what each school, grade, class, role or person sees. The most specific rule wins: person › class › grade › school › role › plan › default.
Visibility.pickKey: Pick an item on the left to see and change who sees it.
Visibility.rulesHelp: Hide or show this for someone. If two rules at the same level disagree, hide wins.
Visibility.noRules: No rules — everyone gets the default.
Visibility.whoSeesHelp: Each school, grade and class, and each role on its own. Rules for individual people are in the list above.
Visibility.checkUserHelp: See exactly what one person gets, and which rule decided it.
Visibility.userNotFound: No user with that email or username.
Visibility.flagsHelp: Turn unfinished features on for everyone, for chosen schools/classes/roles, or off.

Plans.title: Plans
Plans.intro: What each plan includes, and which plan each school is on.
Plans.billingOff: Billing is off: every school uses the Free plan, which includes everything. The checks still run, so switching billing on later just works.
Plans.everything: Everything (all modules and features, no limits)

SchoolTheme.title: School colour
SchoolTheme.help: Replaces the navy in staff portals for this school. It must be readable (WCAG AA, 4.5:1) — dark mode is adjusted automatically.
